mapper.sql: id, account_id, asset_type, origin, storage_mode, storage_key, original_filename, content_type, size_bytes, sha256, duration_ms, status, created_at, deleted_at, checksum_verified_at, detected_content_type, detected_container, detected_codec, width, height, validation_error_code, validation_error_detail, validated_at
mapper.select: INSERT INTO media_asset_checksums (account_id, sha256, media_asset_id) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{sha256}, #{mediaAssetId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.assets.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.MediaAssetUuidTypeHandler}) ON CONFLICT (account_id, sha256) DO NOTHING RETURNING media_asset_id

INSERT INTO media_assets (id, account_id, asset_type, origin, storage_key, original_filename, content_type, size_bytes, sha256, duration_ms, status, checksum_verified_at) VALUES (#{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.assets.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.MediaAssetUuidTypeHandler}, #{accountId}, #{assetType}, #{origin}, #{storageKey}, #{originalFilename}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{sha256}, #{durationMs}, 'VALIDATING', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) RETURNING id

INSERT INTO media_assets (id, account_id, asset_type, origin, storage_mode, storage_key, original_filename, content_type, size_bytes, sha256, duration_ms, status, checksum_verified_at) VALUES (#{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.assets.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.MediaAssetUuidTypeHandler}, #{accountId}, #{assetType}, 'LOCAL_ONLY', 'LOCAL_ONLY', NULL, #{originalFilename}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{sha256}, #{durationMs}, 'READY', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) RETURNING id
SELECT FROM media_assets WHERE AND id = #{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.assets.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.MediaAssetUuidTypeHandler}

SELECT asset.id, asset.account_id, asset.asset_type, asset.origin, asset.storage_key, asset.original_filename, asset.content_type, asset.size_bytes, asset.sha256, asset.duration_ms, asset.status, asset.created_at, asset.deleted_at, asset.checksum_verified_at FROM media_assets asset JOIN media_asset_checksums canonical ON canonical.media_asset_id = asset.id AND canonical.account_id = asset.account_id WHERE asset.account_id = #{accountId} AND asset.status = 'READY' AND asset.deleted_at IS NULL AND canonical.sha256 = #{sha256} LIMIT 1
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM media_assets WHERE storage_key = #{storageKey} AND status = 'READY' AND deleted_at IS NULL )
mapper.update: UPDATE media_assets SET status = 'READY', checksum_verified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND id = #{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.assets.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.MediaAssetUuidTypeHandler} AND status = 'VALIDATING' AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE media_assets m SET status = 'DELETED', deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE m.account_id = #{accountId} AND m.id = #{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.assets.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.MediaAssetUuidTypeHandler} AND m.status = 'READY' AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM narration_parts p WHERE p.media_asset_id = m.id )
